defects.description: The Deployment's selector matchLabels is `run: web`, but the pod template labels are `run: my-nginx`; a Deployment's selector must match its template labels.
paraphrases: matchLabels (run: web) does not match the template labels (run: my-nginx), so the Deployment is invalid.
The Deployment selects `run: web` but labels its pods `run: my-nginx`.
Selector/template label mismatch inside the Deployment.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the Deployment selector (line 8) to the pod template labels (line 13); should be run: my-nginx.

defects.description: The container listens on `containerPort: 8080`, but the Service exposes port 80 with no targetPort (so it routes to pod port 80); the container port and the Service's target port do not match.
paraphrases: The container port (8080) does not match the Service port 80 it is meant to back.
Service traffic to port 80 will not reach the container listening on 8080.
Port mismatch between the container (8080) and the Service (80).
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the containerPort (line 19) with the Service port (line 29); should be 80.

defects.description: The Service selector is `run: nginx`, which matches no pods: the Deployment labels its pods `run: my-nginx`, so the Service selects nothing.
paraphrases: The Service selector `run: nginx` does not match the pod label `run: my-nginx`.
No pods carry the label `run: nginx`, so the Service has no endpoints.
Service selector points at a label that no pod has.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the Service selector (line 32) to the pod template labels (line 13); should be run: my-nginx.
